title: Job: My Life Is a Breath

questions.question: What is man's life on earth compared to?
questions.explanation: Job 7:1 (ESV): "Has not man a hard service on earth, and are not his days like the days of a hired hand?"

questions.question: What is Job allotted?
options: Months of emptiness and nights of misery
questions.correctAnswer: Months of emptiness and nights of misery
questions.explanation: Job 7:3 (ESV): "so I am allotted months of emptiness, and nights of misery are apportioned to me."

questions.question: My days are swifter than what?
questions.explanation: Job 7:6 (ESV): "My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle and come to their end without hope."

questions.question: What is Job's flesh clothed with?
questions.explanation: Job 7:5 (ESV): "My flesh is clothed with worms and dirt; my skin hardens, then breaks out afresh."

questions.question: Remember that my life is a what?
questions.explanation: Job 7:7 (ESV): "Remember that my life is a breath; my eye will never again see good."

questions.question: What terrifies Job?
questions.explanation: Job 7:14 (ESV): "then you scare me with dreams and terrify me with visions,"

questions.question: What would Job choose over his suffering?
questions.explanation: Job 7:15 (ESV): "so that I would choose strangling and death rather than my bones."

questions.question: What does Job ask God to do?
options: Leave me alone, for my days are a breath
questions.correctAnswer: Leave me alone, for my days are a breath
questions.explanation: Job 7:16 (ESV): "I loathe my life; I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are a breath."

questions.question: How often does God visit man?
questions.explanation: Job 7:18 (ESV): "and visit him every morning and test him every moment?"

questions.question: Why have I become a burden to you?
options: Job said this to his friends
questions.explanation: Job 7:20 (ESV): "Why have you made me your mark? Why have I become a burden to you?"

questions.question: Who sees Job no more?
options: The eye of him who sees me
questions.correctAnswer: The eye of him who sees me
questions.explanation: Job 7:8 (ESV): "The eye of him who sees me will behold me no more; while your eyes are on me, I shall be gone."

questions.question: What happens to he who goes down to Sheol?
questions.explanation: Job 7:9 (ESV): "As the cloud fades and vanishes, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come up;"

questions.question: Am I the sea, or a sea monster, that you set a guard over me?
questions.explanation: Job 7:12 (ESV): "Am I the sea, or a sea monster, that you set a guard over me?"

questions.question: Till when will God not leave him alone?
questions.explanation: Job 7:19 (ESV): "How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone till I swallow my spit?"

questions.question: What does Job ask regarding his transgression?
options: Why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity?
questions.correctAnswer: Why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity?
questions.explanation: Job 7:21 (ESV): "Why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity?"

key_verse_text: What is man, that you make so much of him, and that you set your heart on him,
